scientific_motivation: v1.344 and v1.345 demonstrated negative 7-island beetle spatial mean under every one-island deletion and 18 fixed sampling half-Event splits. That is not a CI, significance or guarantee of direction in unseen islands. Audit uncertainty at island grain before journal submission, compare separate axes and paired guild contrast.

fixed_calculations.island_value_unit: Each original source island gets one mean temporal difference or spatial beta change per guild. Original forest-transect pairs, sampling Event split salts and cross-guild sites are NOT treated as independent draws.
group_stats: Araneae original B3-minus-B1 spatial Simpson β
Coleoptera original B3-minus-B1 spatial Simpson β
fixed_calculations.paired_guild_spatial_difference: Coleoptera spatial Simpson B3−B1 minus Araneae spatial Simpson B3−B1 within the SAME original seven island codes; physical site sets differ (28 vs 29), so guild difference is exploratory matched-context, not a taxonomic causal interaction.
fixed_calculations.numeric_interval: Naive descriptive seven-island mean±t(0.975, df6)×sampleSD/sqrt(7), with t-critical = 2.4469118511449692, and all seven island values reported. Island contexts share one archipelago; this interval is NOT ecological uncertainty corrected for archipelago dependence or unequal sampling.
fixed_calculations.null: All 2^7=128 independent island-sign choices for each centered signed source-island effect, two-sided absolute mean tail; assumes exchangeability/symmetric null around zero, exploratory POST OUTCOME, no multiplicity-corrected confirmatory p-values. Report all source signs and exact denominator 128. Null says nothing about underlying species detection probabilities.
fixed_calculations.support_interpretation: A negative LOO mean for beetle in 7/7 dependent deletions does not imply a 95% CI that excludes zero. If spatial interval includes zero or sign-flip p≥0.05, explicitly downgrade to mean observed convergence and no population-wide island-direction significance. Retain strong observed within-phase-excess 7/7 source signs without interpreting as true biological occupancy correction.
fixed_calculations.no_extrapolation: 7 islands do NOT represent independent archipelago replications; do not use 49 beetle plot pairs, 56 spider pairs, 18 half-salts or individual 4620 Event rows as uncertainty n.
